title: Strategic Management in Hospitality and Tourism

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the concepts, roles, and unique aspects of strategic management in hospitality and tourism.
Analyze internal and external business environments for hospitality and tourism firms.
Analyze competitive strategies and market positioning for hospitality and tourism firms.
Conduct SWOT analysis for hospitality and tourism firms.
Develop strategic plans for hospitality and tourism firms.
Analyze resources and capabilities for strategic advantage in hospitality and tourism.
Manage organizational change in the context of strategic implementation for hospitality and tourism firms.
Apply strategic management concepts to real-world case studies in hospitality and tourism.
Evaluate and select strategic options for hospitality and tourism firms.
Present strategic analysis and recommendations effectively.
